name: Outlaw Tools v0.9.1
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.9.1

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.9.1

## Economy Data

- Check material identity mappings before refreshing prices, just as for equipment. A fresh quote cannot hide an expired or failed mapping.
- Resolve raw and refined commodities by their exact game identity and form. Conflicting or ambiguous identities cannot reuse a stored provider ID or similar name; resource refresh clears obsolete IDs when no match remains.
- Keep previously cached material quotes available offline with a stale identity-mapping warning. Refresh public data to validate the mapping before requesting new prices.
- Preserve exact game-UUID Marketplace history queries and existing read-only data boundaries. No player stock or receipts change.

## Roadmap

- Update the in-app roadmap to reflect the saved Routes workspace released in v0.9.0. Wider acquisition adapters, source/build health, Link, Deck and voice remain separate work.

## Downloads

- Windows installer and Linux x86_64 archive, with SHA-256 checksums.
